build_rwrl_dataset: build a TF dataset of RWRL SARSA tuples from TFRecord shards for offline RL training
create_rwrl_environment: create a Real World RL environment for a given domain and task with single precision wrapper
convert_tf_example_to_reverb_sample: convert a TF Example episode into SARSA Reverb replay samples for offline RL
deflatten_nested_dict: deflatten a flat dictionary with delimited keys back into its original nested structure
parse_tf_example_features: parse a TF Example string tensor and return its feature description with fixed length features
